verdict.rationale: Drata's public APIv2 documents a Custom Connections resource (create, update, delete) and pitches it as a way to connect on-premise tools and custom workflows to automate evidence collection. It also documents Evidence Library create/update endpoints, an endpoint to push device data into a custom connection, and OAuth setup for API access. This covers the core of building private integrations that push evidence from uncatalogued systems. missing for 10: an explicit endpoint for pushing custom test pass/fail results (the Monitoring Tests endpoints only show list/update/exclusions), a non-experimental custom device-push endpoint (it is marked 🧪), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths (all returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of custom-integration use.
